senses.gloss:
1. रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see col. 3), sounded,
filled with the cry (of animals), made to resound,
[]
rendered vocal; (अम्), n. any cry or noise, yell,
roar, humming (of bees), the note of birds; song.
—रुत-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, understanding the cries (of
animals); (अस्), m. an augur.
—रुत-व्याज, अस्, m.
simulated cry or sound; mimicry.

2. रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see col. 2), broken to
pieces, divided, &c.

रुत रुत, &c. See under rt. 1. रु, p. 847,
col. 2.

रुतायत (?), अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. रुत), rendered
vocal (by the sound of birds, &c.).
